label: Cookie to set
description: How an answer sets one cookie: the field of the answer it takes (`from`), or `clear` to drop the cookie whatever the answer; `omit` keeps the field out of the body once the cookie has it. HttpOnly unless said otherwise, SameSite=Lax by default, Path=/ by default.

from.description: the field of the answer whose value the cookie takes; absent with clear

clear.description: true: the cookie is dropped (Max-Age=0), whatever the answer

omit.description: true: the field is left out of the body once the cookie has it
